evidence: Has the Mining label and restructures block template orchestration across src/node/block_template_manager.*, src/node/miner.*, and src/rpc/mining.cpp.
rationale: Consolidates template construction, options, and tip-wait helpers into `BlockTemplateManager`, eliminating redundant block copying in template generation and unblocking downstream mining improvements like fee-inflow tracking (#33922). Reviewers note it makes the mining boundary explicit and resolves dangling reference hazards during mempool replacement.
